liga_casa_alpha_resumen: Alpha starts from the whole Nasdaq with enough liquidity and filters it down to five companies. It builds its portfolio once a month, after the close of the last trading day.
liga_casa_alpha_paso_1_texto: Every Nasdaq company that trades a minimum amount of money each day: about 2,800. No sectors or sizes are picked in advance.
liga_casa_alpha_paso_2_texto: Each company gets a score from 1 to 100 based on four equally weighted questions: its fundamentals, its valuation, its financing risk and its next catalyst.
liga_casa_alpha_paso_3_texto: The top 100 are analyzed one by one with their data, their recent headlines and the market context of the day: data, event calendar and news. The result is a final score and a written report.
liga_casa_alpha_paso_4_texto: The 15 with the best final score go through. It is a fixed rule, not an opinion: if two tie, the one with the larger market cap wins.
liga_casa_alpha_paso_5_texto: Five of the 15 are chosen and the weight is split, with a maximum of 35% per company and fully invested. The code works out the amounts, not the model.
liga_casa_lambda_resumen: Lambda is the mechanical version: each company's score and a fixed rule, with no second reading and no discretionary weighting.
liga_casa_lambda_paso_1_texto: It uses the same 1-to-100 score that Alpha gives every company in the universe, with four equally weighted questions.
liga_casa_lambda_paso_2_texto: It ranks the universe by score and keeps the top five, with a maximum of two per industry.
liga_casa_lambda_paso_3_texto: Each company weighs 20%. There is no in-depth report and no later adjustment.
liga_casa_omega_resumen: Omega does not watch the whole market. It follows a closed group of companies and enters when one plunges, as the month's alerts arrive.
liga_casa_omega_paso_1_texto: Every day it reviews the same group of companies, chosen in advance. It does not score or compare the rest of the market.
liga_casa_omega_paso_2_texto: It fires when one of them falls hard: 40% or more from its last high and far below its all-time high, or when it returns to a floor it had marked before.
liga_casa_omega_paso_3_texto: The portfolio is four slots of $500, $2,000 in total. Alerts fill them in order of arrival and the same company cannot take two slots in a month. An empty slot is cash and earns 0%.
liga_casa_omega_paso_4_texto: Each position closes when it reaches its target, between 11% and 40% depending on how strong the start was, or after 90 days, whichever comes first. There is no price stop. The slot is then free for the next alert.
